title: Jack Rabbit Rachael Rabbit Pomegranate, Kiwi and Watermelon E-Liquid Shortfill 100ml
description: Rachael Rabbit's Pomegranate, Kiwi and Watermelon shortfill unites the rich, juicy essence of pomegranate with the tangy sweetness of kiwi and the hydrating burst of watermelon. This e-liquid weaves together a tapestry of flavours, where the depth of pomegranate and the zest of kiwi perfectly complement the subtle sweetness of watermelon. An added layer of ice ensures a refreshing finale, delivering a vape experience that's as refreshing as it is satisfyingly sweet. This product is presented in a 120ml shortfill bottle, containing 100ml of e-liquid and leaving space for 2 x 10ml nicotine shots. By adding 2 x 10ml, 18mg nicotine shots, you can create 120ml of 3mg e-liquid, allowing for a customized nicotine strength. The 70VG/30PG ratio is ideally suited for sub-ohm vaping, producing a perfect blend of flavourful vape and significant vapour production with high-powered devices. Choosing Rachael Rabbit shortfills offers an economical option for enjoying high-quality flavours, with the flexibility to adjust the nicotine content to your preference. These e-liquids are best paired with advanced sub-ohm kits, catering to vapers who prioritize a robust vaping experience. Crafted in the UK, Rachael Rabbit is dedicated to complex fruit blends. Each e-liquid from their collection features a blend of three distinct flavours, delivering layered and authentic fruit vape experiences that are both unique and memorable.
